criteria.requirement: Implement sqlglot.report_binding.parameter_names(tree) and bind_parameters(query,values,*,strict=True,dialect=None) on completed single-query copies. Replace named Placeholder nodes with real exp literal conversions, repeated uses get independent nodes; literals/comments/identifiers containing colon text stay unchanged. Support None/bool/int/finite float/finite Decimal/str/bytes/date/time/datetime and recursive lists, reject nonfinite/cyclic/unsupported objects and SQL Expr values. Missing parameters always fail; strict rejects extras, nonstrict ignores unused values. Reject positional placeholders explicitly and preserve original AST parents. Never parse parameter text as SQL.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
